# Script parser fixtures

Each `NAME.txt` is an input file; `NAME.json` is the expected result of parsing it:

- `items` — the tree in the language-neutral format of `vic2toolmod.script.printer.to_data`
  (trivia and positions left out);
- `diagnostics` — `severity`, `code`, 1-based `line` and `column` of each problem.

The files are independent of Python on purpose: a port of the parser to another
language (e.g. Rust) can run the same cases. Inputs are Windows-1252 / ASCII and
must stay byte-identical after parsing and printing.

The expected JSON was generated by the parser and reviewed by hand (2026-11-08).
To regenerate after an intended change: `python tests/regenerate_fixtures.py`, then
review the diff.
